title: MEET RESCUE RELAY
text: From finding an animal in need to bringing the right help together. Fictional example shown.

title: YOUR TRUSTED CONTACTS
text: Start with people you trust: rescue teams, receiving clinics and nearby volunteers.

title: ADD SOMEONE WHO CAN HELP
text: Add a name, their services and permission to receive rescue calls.

title: SAVE YOUR CONTACT
text: Save the contact. Their services remain editable whenever you need to update them.

title: TRY A COMPLETE RESCUE
text: Load the example, then make the same decisions you would in your own rescue.

title: DESCRIBE WHAT YOU SEE
text: A dog cannot put weight on its rear leg. The location and a PKR 2,000 budget are ready to review.

title: CLARIFY THE OUTCOME
text: Review the report. Describe what a successful rescue should include.

title: YOUR GOAL, YOUR CHOICE
text: Check the goal and location. Edit anything that is not right before finding help.

title: FIND AVAILABLE HELP
text: Confirm the goal to check your trusted contacts for availability and prices.

title: REVIEW THE FIRST OPTION
text: Greenway Rescue covers all three tasks. Its PKR 3,000 quote is above your budget.

title: FIND ANOTHER OPTION
text: Keep your first offer and ask for another option. Your selected plan stays unchanged.

title: COMPARE COMPLETE PLANS
text: Kindred Rescue offers the same requested tasks for PKR 1,500, within your budget.

title: CHOOSE YOUR PLAN
text: Choose the plan that works for you. You stay in control of the final approval.

title: READ THE REPLIES
text: Open Details & history to see what each helper said about the rescue and price.

title: BACK TO YOUR PLAN
text: The report keeps its replies and prices together. Return to your selected plan to approve it.

title: REVIEW BEFORE APPROVAL
text: Confirm the selected helper, included tasks and price limit.

title: CONFIRM YOUR HELPER
text: Approve the plan. The chosen helper is asked to confirm the agreed work and price.

title: HELP IS CONFIRMED
text: The helper is ready. Keep the rescue up to date as you hear from them.

title: ON THE WAY
text: When the helper confirms departure, record “On the way”.

title: ARRIVAL CONFIRMED
text: Record arrival after it has been confirmed by you or the helper.

title: THEIR PART IS FINISHED
text: Mark the helper’s work as finished once their part of the rescue is complete.

title: CLOSE THE LOOP
text: Add where the animal is now, and confirm that it is safe.

title: A SAFE PLACE. A FINISHED RESCUE.
text: The closing note, helper updates and conversations remain with your report.

title: SHARE AN UPDATE
text: Copy a summary for the people involved. Browsers without clipboard access save a text file instead.

title: RETURN TO YOUR REPORT
text: Use Switch report to return to saved cases. Opening a report preserves the existing history.

title: KEEP YOUR CIRCLE READY
text: Update contacts, report the next incident, and keep the right people connected.
